summary: Backend/desktop-app testing of the 'Remember Me' auto-login bug fix for the BOVO CustomTkinter app. Executed the full pytest suite (47 tests) and the end-to-end GUI repro script under xvfb. All success criteria met: pytest 47/47 PASS (including 6/6 new tests in tests/test_remember_me.py) and /tmp/repro_remember_gui.py exits 0 with 'AUTO-LOGIN OK (Bovo / Admin)'.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix is validated: Database.close() now issues PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE), ensuring the refresh_token is flushed from the SQLite WAL to the main DB file before the app exits. This is the concrete root cause for the user's Windows/antivirus environment where the WAL was being discarded before commit.

RemoteAuthService.try_auto_login now correctly distinguishes network failures (raises AutoLoginNetworkError so the token is retained) from HTTP 401/403 (returns None and clears client.tokens so main._launch_login can purge). Test coverage exists for both branches (test_try_auto_login_raises_network_error, test_try_auto_login_purges_on_401).

test_remember_me.py::test_remember_persists_across_reopen exercises the exact close/reopen cycle the user reported and passes. Combined with /tmp/repro_remember_gui.py which drives the real LoginDialog + real backend at 127.0.0.1:8765 + real refresh_token roundtrip, coverage of the reported bug is strong.

To re-run: `cd /app/bovo && xvfb-run -a python -m pytest tests/ -v` and `cd /app/bovo && xvfb-run -a python /tmp/repro_remember_gui.py`. Both must exit 0. rca of the issue: Root cause: on the user's Windows machine with aggressive antivirus, SQLite's WAL file (settings.db-wal) was being closed/discarded before the checkpoint had merged the pending writes into settings.db, so the just-remembered refresh_token was lost the moment the app exited. Mitigation applied by main agent (verified here): Database.close() now runs PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) BEFORE closing the connection, forcing every pending WAL page to be flushed into the main file. In addition, RemoteAuthService.try_auto_login now separates transient network errors (raises AutoLoginNetworkError, token kept) from real invalid-token responses (returns None, token cleared), preventing the previous behaviour where a momentary network hiccup would purge a perfectly valid refresh_token. LoginDialog._attempt_login also performs a post-write read-back of settings.remembered_refresh_token with a log line, giving diagnostics if the write silently fails.
